amendment: docs/SPEC.md, D8 canonical amendment (owner, 2026-09-11), its owner rationale, and the thirteen Fable addenda 0-12
label: RETROSPECTIVE DIAGNOSTIC — D7 RESULTS PREVIOUSLY OBSERVED

grids.fitting_rule: PROTOCOL.md D7 section 6 applied to the ten LEARNING sessions: a market minute whose HistoricalSeries observation status is OK and which satisfies the clock rule (m + 1) + delay + H <= 390, and whose H = 90 label is available from flytrade.horizon.hold on the price file. Independent of positions, trades and inventory.
grids.evaluation_rule: withheld probe table rows exactly as stored, 2790 reconciled as 279 per session over 10 sessions; Y as stored.
grids.unmatched_rows: a grid row with no DECISION event at its (session, minute) is excluded and counted; coverage is reported
grids.temporal_order_test: max exit_ts over the fitting rows must be strictly less than min market_ts over the evaluation rows, asserted from the data

target.G: net return on notional of a hypothetical fixed-notional LONG entered under the flytrade.horizon fill convention (entry = open of the first available bar with bar_start >= t + 1 market minute, same session; exit = open of the first available bar with bar_start >= entry_minute + 90, same session) and held H = 90 market minutes, with the original cost constants
target.source_fitting: computed by flytrade.horizon.hold from the price file
target.source_evaluation: Y as stored in withheld probe table
target.analysis_only: no learning event, no bankroll change, never summed into an executable PnL

X_FEATURES.source: DECISION.observation.normalized, one value per feature name
X_FEATURES.units: dimensionless, u = tanh(z / 2) in (-1, 1), z the causal z-score over the trailing 60 usable rows ending at the cutoff
X_FEATURES.stored_precision: full float64 as written by flytrade.market.MarketObservation.as_dict

X_SENSORY.source: DECISION.stimulus.rates_hz, the deterministic per-glomerulus ORN drive before Bernoulli spike sampling
X_SENSORY.sequence: none: the encoder emits one constant rate vector per presentation, held over the 20 ms window; the amendment's ordered-sequence clause is satisfied vacuously

verification.reconstruction: both representations are rebuilt from the price file with flytrade.historical.HistoricalSeries.observe and flytrade.encoder.MarketToSensoryEncoder, which see only bars of the same session at minutes <= m, i.e. bar_end <= market_ts
verification.comparison: X_FEATURES compared at full precision; X_SENSORY compared after applying the same round(x, 4) the stored artifact applies, and the unrounded maximum absolute difference is reported as well
verification.on_mismatch: STOP. The mismatch count is reported and no model is fitted.
verification.frozen_trained_cross_check: the frozen_trained log must carry an identical stimulus on every shared evaluation row; the count is reported

preprocessing.rows: no imputation, no clipping, no winsorising; a row with any non-finite value in either representation is excluded and counted
preprocessing.LINEAR: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler fitted on the fitting rows only, applied unchanged to the evaluation rows
preprocessing.NONLINEAR: no scaling; the representation enters the tree ensemble as stored

LINEAR.report: n_iter_ per fit; a ConvergenceWarning is reported, never silenced, and max_iter is never raised

models.score: predict_proba(...)[:, 1], the continuous probability of Y = 1
models.no_tuning: no parameter search, no extra families, no seed search, no model selected by evaluation performance

determinism.test: two consecutive fits of each family on a fixture produce identical scores

models.isolation: these are external measurement tools with supervised access to historical labels; they are not biological models, their results are never attributed to the fly, and they have no runtime path to the decoder, orders, reward, plasticity or observer decisions

orientation.rule: raw AUC on the fitting rows; sign = +1 if that AUC >= 0.5, else -1
orientation.reporting: raw AND oriented per-session AUC; never max(AUC, 1 - AUC)

pca.sign_convention: the component is signed so that its largest-magnitude loading is positive; the target-based orientation sign is a separate factor chosen on fitting rows only
pca.degenerate: a constant or rank-deficient representation makes the PC1 line read 'degenerate' rather than a number

evaluation_metric.auc: flytrade.metrics.roc_auc, midranks, ties at 0.5 credit, one class undefined (None) and never 0.5
evaluation_metric.aggregate: equal-session mean AUC over qualifying evaluation sessions
evaluation_metric.paired: comparisons between X_FEATURES, X_SENSORY and the fly use the same paired evaluation rows and show paired counts
evaluation_metric.matched_participation: NOT computed for D8; flytrade.metrics.matched_participation is not called

level.what: for each of the four models, each oriented feature and PC1: 2000 whole-session draws, mean AUC per draw, 2.5-97.5 percent interval
level.implementation: experiments/d8/bootstrap.py, unit-tested on a fixture against flytrade.metrics.paired_session_bootstrap

paired.what: paired deltas on identical rows and sessions, each diagnostic minus the REFERENCE fly and minus the TRAINED fly, the diagnostic in the first slot

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive and conditional on this dataset and this model fit; minute probes with overlapping 90-minute labels are not independent examples; secondary intervals are not simultaneous family-wise evidence

alignment_audit.source: the LEARNING event log, parsed through flytrade.records
alignment_audit.episodes: the ROUND -> DECISION -> EXECUTION -> OUTCOME -> LEARNING chains of the LEARNING partition
columns: hypothetical net outcome at H = 90 when available
alignment_audit.hypothetical: flytrade.horizon.hold at the original decision minute with the original cost constants; its entry fill must equal the actual entry fill price on every episode and the count is reported
summaries: sign disagreements split by actual sign
alignment_audit.forbidden: no weight update, no replayed reward, no account change, no rewriting of the original events, and the hypothetical outcomes are never booked as portfolio PnL
alignment_audit.caveat: these counterfactuals reuse the original entry times; they do not simulate the trades a fixed-hold policy would have taken, because that policy changes inventory and later entry opportunities. This audit measures alignment, not whether fixed-hold training would succeed.

dependency.unchanged: numpy, scipy, pandas and pyarrow are not moved; the main dependencies list is untouched
dependency.tests_import_sklearn_directly: no importorskip; the gate fails loudly if the extra is missing

isolation.observer: observer/serve.py contains no path under experiments/d8
isolation.d7_untouched: nothing is written under experiments/d7/; the three d7-001 event logs and checkpoints are sha256-hashed before and after the wave and both sets appear in results.md
isolation.byte_identity_guard: re-running experiments/d7/evaluate.py must reproduce withheld-probe-table and context_summary.json byte-identically, and git diff --stat -- experiments/d7 must be empty

readings: detectable ranking from X_SENSORY but not from the fly: supports investigating learning, readout or target alignment; does not prove which component caused the difference
ranking from X_FEATURES but not X_SENSORY: motivates inspecting encoding or diagnostic model mismatch; does not by itself prove irreversible information loss
no stable ranking detected: 'no detectable signal with these methods on these periods', never 'nothing can learn from these inputs'
forbidden: declaring a discovery by selecting the best column or the one interval that excludes 0.5
attributing any diagnostic result to the fly
describing these evaluation dates as a pristine holdout
rewriting D7 as a success; its conclusion B stands
allowed_conclusions.recommendation: bounded, not an automatic authorisation; a negative D8 does not prohibit fixed-hold experiments and a positive D8 does not guarantee they work

boundaries_reproduced_verbatim_in_result: docs/SPEC.md, D8 amendment section 2, the five statements, at the head of the conclusions

delivery.tests: tests/d8/, committed with the section they test
delivery.gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ twice, only at close
delivery.data_out_of_git: data/*/ and experiments/d7/runs/ stay gitignored; D8 writes only small JSON tables and markdown; a derived table above ~1 MB is gitignored and its hash recorded
